# Test data

Hand-built MIDI files that reach a mechanism no ordinary corpus file does. Each is small enough to
read in a hex editor and is generated by a script in `../tools/`, so the file and its recipe travel
together. Nothing here is Roland-derived — these are our own files and can be redistributed.

Sorted by the mechanism a file was built to stress, not by what it sounds like. A file belongs in a
folder because that is the thing it can *falsify*; a probe that happens to use a bank select is not
a bank-select probe.

| folder | what the files stress |
|---|---|
| `lfo/` | the LFO nodes: sharing, the random shapes and the one generator they draw from |

Add a folder when a mechanism gets its second file, and put a README in it saying what the mechanism
is and why the corpus could not reach it. A probe with no explanation is a file nobody will dare
delete and nobody will trust.
